messages:
jess (support): FYI BrightCo reported a deletion lag + missing audit entries after they hit the DELETE objects endpoint. They also saw a billing spike yesterday tied to repeated retries. Can SRE/infra look?

leah (sre): On it. Do we have a repro request id / sample object IDs and region?

jess (support): repro info below. Customer says they called: 

curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/objects?org=brightco&obj=tenant-71a3" 
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

Response: HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 14:12:34 GMT
X-Request-Id: req_3be1a9

But object remained visible in search and in embed-index for ~7 hours. Audit UI shows no delete event for req_3be1a9.

leah (sre): logs? any backend errors around req_3be1a9 or KMS timeouts?

jess (support): pasted logs from their session (redacted keys):

```
2026-03-09T14:12:34Z INFO delete.request id=req_3be1a9 user=brightco region=us-west-2
2026-03-09T14:12:35Z WARN kms.sign id=req_3be1a9 err=timed out after 12000ms code=504
2026-03-09T14:12:35Z ERROR storage.delete id=req_3be1a9 status=queued reason="kms timeout"
2026-03-09T14:12:36Z INFO delete.retry id=req_3be1a9 attempt=2
2026-03-09T14:12:36Z WARN kms.sign id=req_3be1a9 err=connection reset code=524
2026-03-09T14:12:40Z INFO delete.enqueue id=req_3be1a9 shard=svc-indexer-3
```

jess (support): customer also said their client retried DELETE on a 30s interval for ~300 attempts because they didn't get a final error — that explains the billing bump (retries generating more API calls and backend work).

vikram (eng-infra): Interesting — I see a pattern. We had a brief KMS proxy degradation in us-west-2 at ~14:12 that affected sign operations for tenant-scoped keys (rotations hit a throttled HSM pool). The proxy returned transient 504/524. That would enqueue deletes but leave tombstone propagation pending.

vikram (eng-infra): Quick note: when storage.delete gets "kms timeout" we currently enqueue and rely on background requeue + indexer to finish. If the background requeue falls behind, search/index visibility persists.

omar (security): If deletes are delayed we need to preserve evidence for any legal requests. Do NOT run any pruning on tenant-71a3 until legal confirms. Also we need to surface missing audit entries — audit pipeline should record the original request even if KMS failed.

leah (sre): Agreed. Action plan: (1) Pause automatic tombstone compaction for brightco/tenant-71a3 (safeguard) (2) Run targeted re-sign/replay for req_3be1a9 and similar failed deletes (3) Backfill audit events for any requests that hit storage.delete but never wrote to audit log.

jess (support): I'm escalating to legal and letting BrightCo know we're pausing compaction and investigating audit backfill. Will ask them to stop client retries for now (so they don't generate more charge).

vikram (eng-infra): Repro steps for infra: 
1) Find all delete records in delete-queue with status=queued and last_error contains "kms" and org=brightco
2) For a sample, call internal signer with increased timeout: 
```
POST https://internal-signer/v1/sign
{ "key_id": "tenant-71a3", "payload": "delete:req_3be1a9", "timeout_ms": 60000 }
```
3) If sign succeeds, push to indexer queue and mark audit written. If sign fails, escalate to HSM team for capacity.

leah (sre): I'm running query now. If we see >100 queued deletes for BrightCo, we should open a priority incident and request emergency HSM capacity from partners.

sre-bot: Deploy 2026-03-09T13:58:20 UTC rolled out to indexer and signer. No immediate rollbacks detected.

vikram (eng-infra): Noted — deployment timing aligns with the start of degradation window. Could be a config edge-case with signer pool sizing. I'll roll a hotfix to increase signer pool timeouts and expose a more explicit 5xx to clients instead of leaving requests in 'queued' state.

omar (security): Also need a short audit note for Legal: list of affected req_ids, approximate creation timestamps, and whether any data was visible after TTL. Jess, can you capture that and attach to the ticket?

jess (support): Yep — I'll compile and attach the sample IDs (req_3be1a9 + req_3be4f2 + req_3bf443). Also telling customer to stop retries and that we're not pruning while we investigate.

leah (sre): Next steps for me: run query, escalate if >100 queued. Vikram to push signer pool fix. Omar to start legal-preserve note. Jess to coordinate with BrightCo and confirm retries stopped. I'll update thread when query done.

jess (support): Thanks all. Marking P1 until audit backfill confirmed. :white_check_mark:

leah (sre): Query results: found 128 queued deletes for org=brightco in us-west-2, oldest queued at 2026-03-09T14:11:57Z. Opening incident #INC-2026-332.

vikram (eng-infra): Hotfix rolling now to increase signer pool and make failures return 503 immediately to callers (so they get a clear hard failure instead of silent enqueue). ETA 12m.

omar (security): Legal lead looped in. Preserve order placed.

jess (support): Noted — customer paused retries. I'll keep them updated.

leah (sre): I'll follow up with audit backfill script once signer fix lands.

jess (support): Closing the loop here for now — incident opened and interim mitigations in progress. BrightCo will wait for our signal before attempting further deletes.
